text.insert: The dispatch lease is the sole authority to dispatch worker agents and mutate a workflow's allowed checkout surfaces.
owns the one-active-workflow-slot invariant; this page defines the fenced lease and its handoff operations.

Every guarded dispatch or source-mutation command presents the current lease_id. Acquisition mints a fresh fence, so a stale actor from an earlier activation is refused even when it still knows the workflow identity.

props.description: Fenced authority held by at most one run, PR, or sync workflow.

fields.name: lease_id
fields.description: Fencing token minted at acquisition; every worker-dispatch and source-mutation command must present the current lease id, so stale actors from a previous activation are refused.

fields.name: requested_handoff
fields.description: Queued transition that begins after the current owner settles.

fields.name: blockers
fields.description: Reasons the owner cannot settle or release authority.

props.name: DispatchLease

rows: The workflow is establishing authority and validating its start gates.
The workflow owns dispatch and its allowed mutable resources.
Every guarded action carries the current lease id.
No new domain work may start while active work settles.
The blocker list explains every remaining obligation.
The workflow cannot settle or safely continue without recovery or operator action.
The lease remains owned; another workflow cannot start.
Final state and handoff evidence are being committed.
The next workflow cannot acquire authority until release is durable.
props.title: Dispatch lease status values

operations.name: requestDispatch
operations.description: Acquire immediately when authority is free or append one ordered handoff request.

params.name: target_workflow_id
params.description: Durable workflow object that will own the lease.

params.name: expected_game_revision
params.description: CAS fence for the aggregate projection.

operations.name: beginDrain
operations.description: Stop new dispatch while the current owner settles obligations.

operations.name: releaseDispatch
operations.description: Commit final state and handoff evidence, then make authority free.

params.name: handoff_evidence
params.description: Settled work, cancellations, and successor-ready evidence.

operations.name: recoverDispatch
operations.description: Break stale or failed authority only after cancellation and reconciliation evidence is durable.

params.name: recovery_evidence
params.description: Evidence that stale work cannot mutate protected state.

params.name: expected_game_revision
params.description: CAS fence for the aggregate projection.

text.insert: Background-safe evidence ingestion stays outside this lease because it dispatches no agents and mutates no checkout surface.
owns the accepted handoff evidence and recovery trace.
